response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) as fraction
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    fraction,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) as rn
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.zoneref,
  g.insurstat,
  g.record_count,
  g.fraction
FROM grouped g
WHERE g.fraction >= COALESCE(
  (SELECT fraction FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10),
  -1
)
ORDER BY 
  g.fraction DESC,
  g.insurstat NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: When fewer than 10 grouped result rows exist, all rows are included (since all qualify as being among the top 10)
'Missing last' refers to NULL insurstat values sorted to the end, not missing fractions—fractions are always non-NULL (computed as count/total)
